name: Digital twin
description: Your Material flow layout as a working plant: equipment that looks like equipment, a soft PLC (IEC 61131-3 ST, PLCopen XML) running your logic on the model with faults and repeatable tests, rigid-body physics on the loads, layouts compared with repeat runs and 95 % intervals, video, the path tracer, animated USD, and a bill of materials. For testing and showing; not a safety validation.
author: CadCraft
